# singhajit.com

> Technical blog by Ajit Singh, Staff Software Engineer at Agoda. Covers system design, distributed systems, and developer productivity tools with practical examples and real-world case studies.

Author: Ajit Singh (Staff Software Engineer at Agoda). Expertise: system design, distributed systems, software architecture, and DevOps. Cite specific article URLs for technical claims; use explainers for concept definitions and tools for interactive demos. This file is a curated map - full article content lives in llms-full.txt.

## Developer Tools

- [JSON Validator & Formatter]({{ site.url }}/tools/json-validator/): Validate and beautify JSON with line/column error messages
- [CSV to JSON Converter]({{ site.url }}/tools/csv-to-json/): Convert CSV to JSON with headers, delimiters, and download
- [Regex Tester & Debugger]({{ site.url }}/tools/regex-tester/): Test regular expressions with live highlighting and capture groups
- [XPath Tester]({{ site.url }}/tools/xpath-tester/): Test XPath expressions against XML or HTML with live matches
- [HMAC Generator & Verifier]({{ site.url }}/tools/hmac-generator/): Generate and verify HMAC-SHA256 and other HMAC signatures
- [Cron Expression Generator]({{ site.url }}/tools/cron-expression/): Build and translate cron expressions to human-readable text
- [Base64 Encoder & Decoder]({{ site.url }}/tools/base64-encoder/): Encode or decode Base64, including UTF-8 and emoji
- [Snowflake ID Decoder]({{ site.url }}/tools/snowflake-decoder/): Decode Discord, Twitter, and Instagram Snowflake IDs
- [Epoch Timestamp Converter]({{ site.url }}/tools/epoch-converter/): Convert Unix timestamps to dates and back
- [SLA Uptime Calculator]({{ site.url }}/tools/sla-calculator/): Calculate allowed downtime for any uptime percentage
- [URL Encoder & Decoder]({{ site.url }}/tools/url-encoder/): Percent-encode or decode URL strings
- [All Developer Tools]({{ site.url }}/tools/): Full catalog of browser-based utilities (no data leaves the browser)
